name: Glute Kickback
instructions: Kneel on the floor and bend at the waist with your arms extended in front of you, shoulder width apart — a kneeling push-up position. This is the starting position.
Lift one leg up until the hamstring is in line with your back, keeping a 90-degree bend at the knee. Contract the glute and hold for a second.
Return to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the recommended amount of repetitions.
